ghosts.rules: Canned messages and emoji only. No free text — a dead killer must not be able to coach, a dead detective must not be able to solve. Ghosts see the main screen and the living; they carry nothing across.
canned_messages: 👻 the ghost disagrees with this conversation.
👻 the ghost would simply have solved it by now.
👻 someone in this room is lying. (the ghost will not elaborate)
👻 the ghost is pointing at someone. you can't see at who. frustrating, isn't it?
👻 avenge me. or don't. see if the ghost cares.

haunt.effect: Thunderclap audio + screen flicker on one living player's phone.
haunt.note: Purely theatrical, zero information. The scream it produces is the payout.

braun.name: James Braun
braun.played_by: One of the four organizers. Host link holder.
braun.alive_phase: Round 1 only. Works the room as host, greets by character title, drops exactly one line of unease to anyone who asks how he's doing: 'Ask me Sunday, when this week is over.' Explains the phone/badge system in-fiction as party novelty.
braun.dead_phase: At the murder: exits to a back room, switches to the game-master console. Controls round advancement, sees all factions, monitors the prompt engine, and voices the main screen if narration is read aloud.
braun.hard_rule: Braun's player must not be seen by guests after the scream until the reveal. The empty chair is doing story work.

facilitators.name: Leo Raphael
facilitators.title: French Chef
orders: Play as a guest who is obviously not a suspect — you were elbow-deep in service all night and twenty people can confirm it.
If the snail motif has not surfaced in conversation by minute 20 of Investigation, 'notice' the manifest watermark out loud.
Feed hungry players. Feed stuck players a hint with the food.

facilitators.name: Chloe Zimmerman
facilitators.title: Fashion Designer
orders: Work the wallflowers. Your job is that nobody stands alone for more than five minutes.
You notice clothes — use it diegetically: steer talk toward the lapel pins, the ring on the chain, the dress, whichever this game's draw made relevant (your console shows the guilty list).
Never accuse. Point, wonder, and walk away.

facilitators.name: Bertram Ault
facilitators.title: Estate Butler
orders: You handle the physical night: kill the lights on the murder cue, place the nine printed clue QRs per the generation sheet, reset anything guests break.
You are the rules answerer in-fiction: 'How does one... vote, Bertram?' — 'On one's telephone, madam.'
Watch for lost players — anyone staring at their phone for three straight minutes gets a butler at their elbow asking if sir or madam requires anything. Then help them out of character if needed.
